title.en: AN ACT REMITTING THE COLLECTION OF THE LAND TAX FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND MUNICIPALITIES SUB-PROVINCE CATANDUANES, PROVINCE OF ALBAY.
title.orig: AN ACT REMITTING THE COLLECTION OF THE LAND TAX FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND MUNICIPALITIES SUB-PROVINCE CATANDUANES, PROVINCE OF ALBAY.

text.en:
The collection of the land tax within the municipalities of Bagamanoc, Caramoran, Pandan. Payo,
and Biga, in the subprovince of Catanduanes of the Province of Albay, is hereby remitted for the year
nineteen hundred and five, and the inhabitants of said municipalities are hereby exempted from the payment
of said tax for the year nineteen hundred and five.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, June 15, 1905.
